title: Deadly Science
description: Breaking the glass ceiling is never easy, but for some female inventors, science comes at an added price.

title: Rich and Sinful: The Lost Pleasure Palace of Pompeii
description: Archaeologists uncover the secrets of one of Rome's largest and most lavish villas, buried in the eruption of Mt. Vesuvius.

title: I Died... And Came Back
description: A man is admitted to the hospital for a kidney stone but gets more than he bargained for; his near-death experience takes him outside his body and on an unexpected journey; a woman's visit to the 8th wonder of the world leads to her NDE and a physical and spiritual journey.

title: Digital Tsunami: Big Tech, Big AI, Big Brother
description: This documentary will examine how toxic elements of digital environment are dramatically transforming society in negative ways, just as the prophetic, popular futurist Marshall McLuhan predicted 60 years ago.
